g.title: ENERGY008_AUTOMATION
g.text: Prompt 14 C&E + Prompt 15 sequence | Conceptual state logic only

g.title: PRE
g.text: Permits, work scope, handback, revision check

g.title: UTIL
g.text: Required utilities, DCS/UPS, FGS, ESD, U-501/W-501

g.title: INERT
g.text: Approved test package, segregated H2/O2 paths, gas tests

g.title: PACK
g.text: W-201 / ELY-201 / CO2 / H2 packages healthy

g.title: CAT
g.text: OEM catalyst procedure + heat-removal / protection release

g.title: GAS
g.text: Composition, purity, moisture, pressure and maps valid

g.title: RECYCLE
g.text: K-301 OEM sequence, anti-surge, V-301 and U-501 ready

g.title: ADMIT
g.text: Ratio permissive; R-301 temperature / pressure / cooling healthy

g.title: SEP
g.text: E-302 / V-301 / V-302 stable; liquid handling available

g.title: DIST
g.text: T-401 / E-401 / E-402 / V-401 ready; sample/lab basis valid

g.title: QHOLD
g.text: Stop transfer; segregate/hold product pending authority release

g.title: TURN
g.text: Coordinated H2/CO2 demand; stay inside validated maps

g.title: VERIFIED
g.text: No automatic restart; maintenance needs LOTO boundary

g.title: ESD
g.text: Trip/isolate per approved C&E; retain essential functions

g.title: HOLD
g.text: First-out, cause removal, tests, inspection, restart review

g.title: HOLD->PRE
g.text: restart review complete; new start request

g.title: MODE
g.text: Manual cannot bypass ESD, FGS, OEM protection or safety permissives

g.title: GUARD
g.text: Alarm + interlock health • PV quality • package ready
ESD / confirmed FGS / safety-package demand has highest priority
